title: Operations New Action Permission Consistency

items.action: start the new operation flow from the Operations page

migration.reason: The existing fair_crm.operations.create permission is reused.

backend.reason: Existing operation authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

api.reason: No server API contract changes; only the Operations-page create entry point is aligned with existing route authorization.

audit.reason: No mutation or audit behavior changes.

menu.reason: No navigation menu changes are introduced.

route_guard.reason: Operation creation routes already require fair_crm.operations.create; this change aligns the originating page action.

forms.reason: Operation wizard form behavior is unchanged.

notes: OperationsPage previously rendered Yeni Operasyon for users who could read operations but lacked fair_crm.operations.create, even though every /operations/new/* route already requires create permission. The entry point and open modal now fail closed on the existing create permission. Start and cancel row actions are intentionally outside this focused change.
